desc: Ideation: select canonical unordered tree type plus multinomial DP as primary approach.
Implement parser and canonical type IDs with stack and sorted child tuples.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials modulo 998244353 up to N.
Compute DP counts f for each unordered type using grouped child multiplicities.
Handle artificial root/top-level forest and print answer.
Test edge cases: single leaf, chain, repeated identical subtrees, and sample inputs.
